decision_conditions: The operations do not fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E (a) of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015, as amended, as the proposed annex building contains primary living accommodation and the application fails to demonstrate that the proposed annex would be used for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the dwellinghouse.

The operations do not fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E.1 (e) (ii) of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015, as amended, as the proposed building is sited within 2m of the boundary of the curtilage of the dwellinghouse and exceeds 2.5m in height.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for proposed garden room annex to main house
